designationHistory.indexText: Saddle Mountain National Wildlife Refuge was created on November 30, 1971, through a permit from the Atomic Energy Commission (now Energy Department) letting the Fish and Wildlife Service manage part of the Hanford Site's Wahluke Slope.

authority.citation: Permit for Management and Recreational Use of the Wahluke Slope (1971), under the Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956

sources.name: FWS, Hanford Reach National Monument Final CCP/EIS (2008), compatibility determinations

review.by: Accepted on the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's own record (Library decision)
